# Tavara Care

> Tavara is a Care Coordination & Management Platform connecting families in Trinidad & Tobago with trusted caregivers. Families engage caregivers directly; Tavara coordinates matching, scheduling, training oversight, payroll calculation, and quality oversight. Not a placement or employment agency.

Tavara helps families find, hire, and manage in-home caregivers for elderly parents, dementia care, post-surgical recovery, and companion support. Care professionals join to access vetted job opportunities, training, and payroll support. The platform spans the Caribbean with a focus on Trinidad & Tobago.

Standard caregiver rates: $40/hr (Standard), $45/hr (Full Service), $50+/hr (Premium/Specialized). Care management subscriptions: Basic (Free), Active Care ($699/wk), Premium ($899/wk). One-time Caregiver Matching & Placement: $1,399.

- [Community Care Circles](https://tavara.care/community): Join a care circle in your community
- [Urgent Caregivers Needed](https://tavara.care/urgent-caregivers): Live list of caregivers ready to start work
- [Urgent Families Needing Care](https://tavara.care/urgent-families): Live list of families urgently seeking caregivers
- [Legacy Stories](https://tavara.care/legacy-stories): Anonymous care stories that honor the people we care for
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://tavara.care/support/faq): Pricing, plans, the coordination model, and how it works
- [Privacy Policy](https://tavara.care/privacy-policy): How Tavara handles personal and health information

## Locations

- [Caregivers in Port of Spain](https://tavara.care/care/port-of-spain): In-home care across Port of Spain and surrounding neighbourhoods
- [Caregivers in San Fernando](https://tavara.care/care/san-fernando): In-home care across San Fernando and South Trinidad
- [Caregivers in Arima](https://tavara.care/care/arima): In-home care across Arima and East Trinidad
- [Caregivers in Tobago](https://tavara.care/care/tobago): In-home care across Tobago, designed for diaspora coordination

## Services

- [Elder Care at Home](https://tavara.care/services/elder-care): In-home elder care across Trinidad & Tobago
- [Dementia & Alzheimer's Care](https://tavara.care/services/dementia-care): Dementia friendly in-home care, sundowning and memory loss support
- [Post-Surgery Recovery Care](https://tavara.care/services/post-surgery-care): Recovery support at home after hospital discharge
- [Live-In Care](https://tavara.care/services/live-in-care): Continuous in-home support with rotating caregivers

## Blog

- [Tavara Care Blog](https://tavara.care/blog): Guides for families, caregivers, and the village around them
- [How to Find a Trusted Caregiver in Trinidad & Tobago](https://tavara.care/blog/how-to-find-trusted-caregiver-trinidad-tobago): Practical T&T-specific guide to vetting and hiring in-home caregivers
- [Senior Care Costs in Trinidad & Tobago (2026 Guide)](https://tavara.care/blog/senior-care-costs-trinidad-tobago-2026): Transparent 2026 cost breakdown — hourly rates, live-in, subscriptions, what's included
- [When Help Feels Like Pressure: The Emotional Reality of Bringing Care Into the Home](https://tavara.care/blog/when-help-feels-like-pressure): The emotional adjustment families go through when care enters the home
- [Why Families Resist Care at First — And Why That's Normal](https://tavara.care/blog/why-families-resist-care): Why resistance is information, not failure, and how to move through it
- [When a Home Starts Feeling Heavy: Aging, Accumulation & Caregiving](https://tavara.care/blog/when-a-home-starts-feeling-heavy-aging-accumulation-caregiving): Why an overwhelmed home is an emotional problem with logistical symptoms, and how to approach it without rupturing the relationship
- [The Adult Child Trap: Caring for a Parent While Quietly Burning Out](https://tavara.care/blog/adult-child-trap-caring-for-parent-burnout): The specific exhaustion of adult-child caregivers in Caribbean and diaspora families, and what structural relief actually looks like
- [Caribbean Families and Caregiving: Why This Conversation Is So Hard](https://tavara.care/blog/caribbean-families-and-caregiving-why-this-is-hard): Respectability, pride, religion, privacy and diaspora — the cultural reasons hiring care feels different in T&T households
